pet.text: The vacuum has annexed the hallway. My bed is beside its noisy route.
options: Choose a quiet retreat
Stay beside my familiar person
Investigate the noisy hallway

pet.text: Training keeps running past the point where I can concentrate.
options: Take a break and return calmly
Try one familiar cue
Keep repeating despite fatigue

pet.text: The household moves. The old blanket and an unfamiliar room are both waiting.
options: Explore from a familiar safe place
Stay close to the household
Hide from every new routine

prisoner.text: A workshop place overlaps with the group that has been protecting me.
options: Keep the workshop and explain the limit
Arrange a smaller program commitment
Skip the program to keep the group

prisoner.text: A visitor cannot afford another journey this year.
options: Agree on letters and a later visit
Ask the support worker about contact
Insist that they come anyway

prisoner.text: Release planning needs a real address and appointments, not a promise that things will work out.
options: Ask for a supported housing referral
Build a plan with a trusted contact
Leave with no arrangement

guard.text: The shift record omits an inmate concern that another officer dismissed.
options: Record the concern and request a review
Ask a supervisor to witness the next check
Leave the omission alone

guard.text: A colleague offers a favour for overlooking a discrepancy in the count.
options: Refuse and record the discrepancy
Request a second independent count
Accept the favour

guard.text: A report exposes a failure in a team that has also supported me.
options: Submit the dated facts through the review route
Request an independent review of the facts
Rewrite it to protect the team

royal.text: A ceremony promises access to a service that the budget can only deliver in two districts.
options: Fund the two districts and publish the limit
Reduce the ceremony and extend access later
Promise every district immediately

royal.text: The palace schedule excludes residents who cannot travel to the capital.
options: Hold a regional consultation
Fund a documented local delegation
Count the capital crowd as everyone

royal.text: An heir asks what duties and unfinished promises actually come with the title.
options: Keep a public duty and handover register
Share the duties with experienced staff
Give a ceremonial speech without records

witch.text: A neighbour wants a spell to settle a dispute with someone who has not agreed to it.
options: Offer ordinary mediation instead
Discuss a limited consensual alternative
Promise control over the other person

witch.text: An apprentice misreads a harmless practice charm and wants to quit.
options: Repeat a smaller supervised exercise
Pause training and review the notes
Humiliate them for the mistake

witch.text: My spell notes are useful, but some results are uncertain.
options: Leave annotated limits for the next learner
Teach only the verified exercises
Publish every guess as a proven spell

vampire.text: A companion notices that every meeting happens after sunset.
options: Explain the limits I can safely share
Agree on contact without disclosure
Invent another story each time

vampire.text: Decades away changed the place I still call home.
options: Learn about the people here now
Reconnect with one surviving contact
Expect the town to stay as I remember

vampire.text: A powerful ally demands permanent loyalty with no room for refusal.
options: Refuse the unrestricted pledge
Offer a specific limited agreement
Agree to every future demand

revenant.text: Someone remembers my ending differently from the story I told myself.
options: Listen and record both memories
Keep a respectful boundary
Demand their memory match mine

revenant.text: An unfinished promise involves someone who has already rebuilt their life.
options: Ask whether help is still wanted
Offer a limited apology without a demand
Insist on restoring the old arrangement

revenant.text: A second life cannot repair every part of the first.
options: Keep a realistic plan for one remaining duty
Choose a new life and close the old promise honestly
Promise to undo everything

super.text: The cameras follow a spectacular rescue while an unglamorous shelter still needs help.
options: Return for the quieter work
Coordinate volunteers before leaving
Chase the next camera

super.text: A rival offers victory if I ignore the damage it would cause.
options: Refuse and choose a slower rescue
Ask for a safer joint plan
Take the quick victory

super.text: Residents ask for an account of the damage left by my intervention.
options: Publish the damage and repair plan
Invite an independent review
Use my popularity to dismiss them

pirate.text: The crew wants different destinations, and supplies allow only one long voyage.
options: Compare supplies and hold a crew vote
Choose a shorter voyage with a reserve
Promise every destination

pirate.text: Ship repairs compete with the share promised to the crew.
options: Agree on a repair reserve before dividing shares
Shorten the voyage and keep the agreement
Take the reserve without explaining

pirate.text: The voyage ends with less reward than the crew expected.
options: Share according to the recorded agreement
Offer a voluntary deferred share with limits
Keep the reward and blame the crew

colonist.text: Ration supplies cover the essential needs, but not every preferred meal.
options: Publish equal essentials and limited extras
Ask residents about substitutions
Give the best supplies to the loudest group

colonist.text: A maintenance task overlaps a long-awaited settlement celebration.
options: Complete the essential repair and shorten the celebration
Share duties and preserve a smaller gathering
Delay the fault and hope

colonist.text: The next arrivals need instructions that work after the original crew leaves.
options: Train replacements and record limits
Keep a smaller supervised handover
Leave the opening speech as the only guide

traveler.text: Knowledge from another era tempts me to promise a device this place cannot build.
options: Work with locally available materials
Explain the idea without promising a working device
Guarantee an impossible machine

traveler.text: A local friend notices dates in my story that do not fit this era.
options: Explain my limits without another invented date
Keep a clear boundary about my past
Add a bigger story to cover the mismatch

traveler.text: Leaving this era would end a local commitment that someone relies on.
options: Arrange a real handover before leaving
Explain an early departure and close the commitment
Disappear without a message
